from math import gcd

p = 2017
units = {a for a in range(1, p) if gcd(a, p) == 1}

def generated_subgroup(g):
    seen = set()
    x = 1
    while x not in seen:
        seen.add(x)
        x = x * g % p
    return seen

# Exhaustively check the submitted rejection criterion on every unit.
rejected = [g for g in sorted(units) if pow(g, p - 1, p) == 1]
accepted = [g for g in sorted(units) if pow(g, p - 1, p) != 1]

# Independently find a generator by enumerating its complete subgroup.
generator = None
for g in sorted(units):
    subgroup = generated_subgroup(g)
    if subgroup == units:
        generator = g
        break

print("Number of units modulo 2017:", len(units))
print("Units rejected by the submitted criterion:", len(rejected))
print("Units accepted by the submitted criterion:", len(accepted))

if generator is not None:
    print("Verified generator:", generator)
    print("Order of generator:", len(generated_subgroup(generator)))
    print("Generator^(2016) modulo 2017:", pow(generator, 2016, p))
    print("Its powers generate every unit: True")

    # The submitted program requires a unit with this power unequal to 1.
    # Both coprimality and modular exponentiation depend only on g modulo p,
    # so exhaustive checking of all unit residues proves it never returns.
    if not accepted:
        print("The submitted search never terminates: no residue meets its condition.")
        print("CHECK FAIL")
    else:
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
else:
    print("No generator exists under exhaustive enumeration.")
    print("CHECK FAIL")
